facts.fact: 陌生人走进空地，现场一度混乱
facts.anchor: Strangers were striding into the clearing.
“We are to set sail in an hour’s time.”
“Elora Ulinoor, I assume? Meet your Guard, Dallin Rasmus.”
The Guard pivoted to face her head-on.
